payload.text: The Brennecke Institute originated the thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery, designed to suppress electrolyte crossover and improve durability. The independent audit retracted the original 12,000-cycle claim; the corrected governing cycle life is 8,400 cycles. The battery has a gravimetric energy density of 148 Wh/kg and a projected stack-level cost of $61/kWh at 500 MWh manufacturing scale. Its key limitation is a 4 °C operating-temperature floor, below which the dopant precipitates and cycling must stop.

FLAGS: Source C reports both “4,800 cycles” to the 80% capacity knee and “8,400 cycles” as the corrected governing cycle-life figure.
VERDICT: APPROVE
